sources.snippet: The SO‑101 is the next‑generation version of the SO‑100 robot arm, originally designed by the RobotStudio in collaboration with Hugging Face. It has improved wiring, is easier to assemble (no gear removal) and uses updated motors for the leader arm. These arms are designed to work seamlessly with the open‑source 🤗 LeRobot library.
